tools.name: ask_kinro
tools.description: Ask Kinro, a licensed business insurance broker, about the user’s business insurance: what coverage fits the business, carrier eligibility and exclusions, and quotes. Kinro’s AI advisor, Leo, answers. Kinro is not tied to any carrier: it gets real quotes from several carriers in one conversation, so

tools.name: get_kinro_messages
tools.description: Read this conversation with Kinro and get Kinro's new messages: the user's messages and Kinro's, oldest first, with each Kinro message you have not received before marked new. Show the user every new message as written, including links. Returns the latest 5 messages by default; set limit (up to 100)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_kinro, get_kinro_messages · Private data: ask_kinro · Public sink: ask_kinro.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_kinro, get_kinro_messages · Private data: ask_kinro · Public sink: ask_kinro

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
